headline: Expiry‑day trading is costing you

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: Your expiry‑day trades accounted for 90 trades and produced a loss of ₹1,16,891, which translates to an average loss of ₹1,299 per trade and a win rate of 29%. This slice also saw a 28% loss on average, compared with a 5% loss on the rest of your trades (124 trades) that averaged a loss of ₹449 and a win rate of 37%.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: Consider using this rule for the next month.
